input.args: Issue 567: Verification of an empty varargs call fails when isNotNull() is used. Source: ArgumentMatchers.isNotNull() (ArgumentMatchers.java:774) delegates to notNull(), which records NotNull.NOT_NULL with type Object. In MatcherApplicationStrategy.forEachMatcherAndArgument (mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/invocation/MatcherApplicationStrategy.java:60-66), the vararg branch only triggers when the last matcher's type() is assignable to the last parameter type (String[]); Object is not, so the call falls back to the expanded args (0 elements) vs 1 matcher, and it fails. isNotNull(Class) (line 794) with String[].class sets the type and should match.

final: {"number": 567, "label": "bug", "route": "repro-check", "related": [616, 3001], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/invocation/MatcherApplicationStrategy.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/ArgumentMatchers.java", "mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/internal/matchers/NotNull.java"], "reply": "Thanks for the report. The snippet and the expected and actual behaviour are clear, so I could reproduce it as written. The cause is in MatcherApplicationStrategy: isNotNull() records a matcher typed as Object, so Mockito does not treat it as a vararg matcher and compares it against the zero expanded arguments, which fails. The cast in your second test does not change the recorded type. As a workaround, isNotNull(String[].class) in ArgumentMatchers sets the array type and should match the empty varargs call. The class responsible is MatcherApplicationStrategy."}
